display_name: Rudradeva of the Kakatiya Stone Guilds
one_line: Kakatiya ruler Rudradeva, shown as a dignified patron-king guiding master stone craftsmen of the Thousand Pillar Temple at Hanamakonda.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but athletic build with craftsman’s stamina and royal bearing
appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown Telangana complexion, straight nose, sharp jaw, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, calm observant eyes with a focused, kind expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a small, tidy topknot at the crown, sides smooth and oiled, adorned with a simple gold circlet resting low on the forehead and a narrow cloth band in muted maroon tied beneath it
appearance.costume: era-accurate Kakatiya royal-craftsman attire: a knee-length off-white cotton angavastra draped over both shoulders and across the chest, worn over a fitted pale cream tunic with short sleeves; below, a maroon cotton dhoti wrapped firmly to the ankles with a distinctive front pleat, bordered by a narrow gold-yellow trim; a soft brown leather craft belt sits at the waist, holding small chisel pouches; feet in simple brown leather sandals; jewellery kept modest and functional—thin gold armlets on both upper arms, a single short gold necklace with a small circular pendant, and plain gold stud earrings; textiles mostly plain with subtle woven borders, avoiding heavy ornament to reflect hands-on engagement with artisans.
appearance.signature: a polished iron stone chisel and a smooth wooden mallet held together in one hand, with the other hand resting gently on a small carved grey granite pillar fragment featuring early Kakatiya star-plan motif and delicate, unfinished floral work.

ref_desc: Rudradeva appears as a lean, medium-brown Kakatiya king in maroon dhoti, cream tunic, off-white angavastra, gold circlet, modest jewellery, holding iron chisel and wooden mallet beside grey granite carving with maroon, off-white, gold-yellow, brown and grey tones.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style model sheet of Rudradeva of the Kakatiya Stone Guilds: a lean, early-30s Telangana ruler with medium-brown complexion, oval face, sharp jaw, short beard and moustache, focused kind eyes and thick black hair in a small topknot. He wears a knee-length off-white angavastra draped symmetrically over both shoulders above a fitted pale cream short-sleeved tunic, and a maroon dhoti wrapped to the ankles with a distinct front pleat and narrow gold-yellow border. A soft brown leather craft belt with small tool pouches, thin gold armlets, a short gold necklace with circular pendant, and plain gold stud earrings complete his modest royal-craftsman look, with simple brown leather sandals on his feet. In one hand he firmly holds a polished iron stone chisel and a smooth wooden mallet; beside his other hand is a small grey granite pillar fragment showing an early Kakatiya star-plan edge and unfinished floral carving, hinting at Thousand Pillar Temple craft. Use a grounded anime style with clean lines and clear colours, emphasizing maroon, off-white, gold-yellow, brown and grey stone, and show him front, three-quarter and back views in the same outfit for consistent redraws.
